meta.description: Canonical Goetsusioji mapping: romanization → Siauzy glyph blocks + progenitor Han spelling. Generated from handfill; do not hand-edit.

fricative_han_diacritic.detail: Chart 1 draws ゜ on Goetsu glyphs for f/s/sh/h. Han progenitor spellings keep unmarked 弗/式/兴 for f/s/sh; h uses 奧ﾟ. Do not rewrite Han to match glyph diacritics.

final_y_han.detail: Chart 2 labels y as 私(空韻); Han spelling uses glyph-shape 厶 (handfill).

aoq.detail: Chart 2 example writes aoq as aon-glyph + く (後加), not a+o+-q.

yu_rule5.detail: No separate yu final in normal use (use medial iu). When marked explicitly, prefer grid syllable yu (U+F4A9, Han 云无) as y-initial + u-final; do not invent CSS stacking.

shian.detail: Rule 3: shian is written as the shan head block (no separate i). Alias shan → shian for lookup.

U+F03C_U+F03D.detail: Header slots carry Han へ / ケ with empty romanization; treated as tentative sandhi mark glyphs for -x / -·. Not used in syllable goetsu.

beside_block_glyph.detail: Finals/codas placed beside a head block use header-row glyphs U+F021–U+F03B (e.g. au=U+F02E, -q=U+F03B), not U+F5xx component pieces.

empty_grid_column.detail: Empty romanization slots are unused chart cells (notably col 0x0C and sparse empties). Not mapped to syllables.

rules.name: simple
rules.zh: 聲母符號和韻母符號拼合起來就可以表達一個字音，拼寫時聲母在上，韻母在下。

rules.name: with_medial
rules.zh: 拼寫時聲母在上，介母在其下，韻母在介母之右。

rules.name: implicit_i
rules.zh: ch(i)、c(i)、j(i) 和 sh(i)、zh(i) 視為已含介母 i，因此不用再標出介音 i。

rules.name: compound_final
rules.zh: aeq、oeq、eoq、ai、ei 等有專門寫法（下+右布局），同時按照介音字的方式進行拼寫。

rules.name: yu
rules.zh: 由於目前撮口音 iu 基本上不區分尖團，所以不再單獨設立 yu 韻母；如需表記，用 y+u（grid yu）。

tones.note: entering; expressed via checked final / coda
sandhi middle dot; glyph U+F03D (ケ) tentatively
